text: That afternoon: Holmes and Watson come to Stoke Moran as promised
why: Holmes promised an early-afternoon visit (¶82), and ¶116-125 show them arriving at Stoke Moran that afternoon, with Holmes greeting Miss Stoner as promised.

text: That day: Holmes and Watson climb the stile, and Holmes explains what he wanted the driver to think
why: ¶125 says 'as we climbed the stile', and Holmes explains he wanted the driver to think they came as architects or on business, to stop his gossip.
